The '''2018–19 season''' was '''[[Juventus FC|Juventus Football Club]]''''s 121st in existence and 12th consecutive season in the top-flight of [[Football in Italy|Italian football]].

On 10 July 2018, [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] became the [[List of most expensive association football transfers|highest ever transfer for an Italian club]] with [[Transfer of Cristiano Ronaldo from Real Madrid C.F. to Juventus F.C.|his €100 million transfer]] from [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]].<ref name="auto">{{cite press release |title=Cristiano Ronaldo signs for Juventus!|url=http://www.juventus.com/en/news/news/2018/cristiano-ronaldo-signs-for-juventus.php |publisher=Juventus FC |date=10 July 2018}}</ref>

The season was the first since [[2000–01 Juventus FC season|2000–01]] without [[Gianluigi Buffon]], who joined [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] (although he returned for the [[2019–20 Juventus FC season|following season]] for a second and final spell).
